Definition: a prophetess or (generally) inspired woman; by implication, a poetess; by association a prophet's wife
BiblicalUsage: 1) prophetess; 1a) ancient type endowed with gift of song (Miriam); 1b) later type consulted for a word (Huldah); 1c) false prophetess (Noadiah); 1d) wife of Isaiah the prophet
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
